**Visual Analysis:**

- **Affected part**: Sugarcane leaf blade (close-up view)
- **Leaf color**: Light green, otherwise healthy-looking lamina
- **Lesions**: 2–3 discrete, elongated, reddish-brown to dark-brown spots/lesions visible on the leaf surface
- **Lesion shape**: Elongated/irregular, concentrated in patches on the leaf
- **No other symptoms**: No white pencil lines, no midrib yellowing, no twisting/malformation, no whip structures, no mosaic/streak patterning, no bushy tillering visible

**Reasoning through the classes:**

- **Brown_Spot**: Produces brownish lesions (Cercospora longipes) on sugarcane leaves — the reddish-brown elongated spots match well
- **Yellow_Spot**: Would show yellow lesions — not present here
- **Leaf_Scald**: Requires a white "pencil line" with yellow border — absent
- **Yellow_Leaf**: Requires midrib yellowing — absent
- **Pokkah_Boeng**: Requires twisted/malformed leaves with chlorosis — absent
- **Grassy_Shoot / Sett_Rot / Streak_Mosaic / Sugarcane_Mosaic**: None of their hallmark features (bushy tillers, rotting, mosaic/streak patterns) are present

The discrete reddish-brown elongated lesions on an otherwise green sugarcane leaf are the hallmark of **Brown_Spot** (Cercospora longipes).
